messages.content: You are a local model studio helper.
List two safe tools for an agent.
A calculator and a dataset report reader are safe bounded tools.
How many models should be loaded at once in the benchmark?
Load one model at a time and release it before the next model.
It means a very small bounded run, often one or two optimizer steps.
Report the exact stage and a concise safe error message.
What should a chat template do?
It should format role-based messages in the tokenizer's expected format.
